:''Also known as: [[Virtual Sets to Virtual Blocks]]. Not to be confused with the [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]], or with modern [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Current Virtual]] set numbers (e.g. [[Virtual Set 18]] from 2022).''

In '''2009''' the [[Players Committee]] reorganized the '''original numbered Virtual Sets''' (the 2002&ndash;2009 PDF-slip era) into six thematic '''Virtual Blocks'''. The planned 18th set, '''Fifth Anthology''', was previewed in June 2009 but never shipped as a standalone <code>VirtualCards18.pdf</code>. Its cards were released inside '''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''' (later [[Virtual Block 6]]).

== Background: numbered Virtual Sets (2002&ndash;2009) ==

From '''2002''' through early '''2009''', the Players Committee published printable Virtual game-text slips as '''numbered Virtual Sets''' (VS1&ndash;VS17 on the surviving CDN / virtual-slips library).<ref name="vslips">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/virtual-slips/ Virtual slips], starwarsccg.org &mdash; Legacy Virtual Sets list '''VS1&ndash;VS17'''</ref><ref name="vc17">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf] (Virtual Set 17: The Force Unleashed; HTTP '''200''')</ref> The full set index is at [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]].

== August/September 2009 reorganization into Blocks 1&ndash;6 ==

A Players Committee homepage snapshot from '''18 September 2009''' carries news about '''Reflections IV''' together with virtual-set realignment.<ref name="reorg2009">[https://web.archive.org/web/20090918131415/http://www.starwarsccg.org/ starwarsccg.org homepage], Wayback '''18 September 2009'''</ref>

The Block packaging intros are stamped '''Official text as of 7 December 2009''' on [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (same blurb on VirtualBlock2&ndash;5). That intro states:<ref name="blockreorg">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf] (official text as of '''7 December 2009''')</ref>

: ''&ldquo;Since the reorganization of the previous 18 virtual sets, there are now six blocks structured by theme. The first three blocks cover the classic trilogy, block 4 expands the expanded universe, the fifth block buffs the Old Republic, and block 6 is a mix - Reflections IV.&rdquo;''

{| class="wikitable"
! Block !! Theme (per Block 1 intro) !! Wiki hub
|-

|-
| 4 || Expanded universe || [[Virtual Block 4]]
|-
| 5 || Old Republic || [[Virtual Block 5]]
|-
| 6 || Mix &mdash; Reflections IV || [[Virtual Block 6]]
|}

Later Legacy material continued as Blocks '''7&ndash;9''' (and [[Virtual Shields]]); those are post-reorg expansions, not part of the original six-block remap. PC virtual-slips separates '''Legacy Virtual Sets (2002&ndash;2009)''' from '''Legacy Virtual Blocks (2009&ndash;2014)'''.<ref name="vslips" />

Block packaging is an organizational layer over the pre-[[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset|2014 Reset]] pool. It is not a rename of every old VS PDF, and it is not the same as post-Reset [[:Category:Current Virtual sets|Current Virtual]] numbering.

== Fifth Anthology (planned VS18) ==

Fifth Anthology was previewed as Original-era Virtual Set 18 in June 2009 and never released as a standalone PDF. Its preview cards shipped inside Reflections IV / Virtual Set 6. Unlike [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|VS19 Galaxy At War]], it was not cancelled.

=== Preview (8 June 2009) ===

A Polish fan preview dated '''8 June 2009''' names '''Fifth Anthology''' as the '''18th virtual set''', with premiere '''planned for July 2009'''. It shows '''six''' preview cards marked '''Virtual Set 18''':<ref name="plfifth">[https://star-wars.pl/News/10466,Preview_Fifth_Anthology.html Preview Fifth Anthology], star-wars.pl, '''8 June 2009'''</ref>

# Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force [A Jedi's Concentration (V)]
# Jabba's Prize (V)
# Maneuvering Flaps &amp; Nick Of Time
# Marquand In Blizzard 6
# Tarkin's Bounty (V)
# We Have A Prisoner &amp; I Can't Shake Him!

=== No standalone VirtualCards18.pdf ===

* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards17.pdf VirtualCards17.pdf] (The Force Unleashed) returns '''HTTP 200'''.<ref name="vc17" />
* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards18.pdf VirtualCards18.pdf] returns '''HTTP 403''' / is not hosted on the PC Legacy CDN path used for VS1&ndash;17.<ref name="vc18miss">CDN probe of VirtualCards18.pdf (HTTP '''403'''); contrast VirtualCards17.pdf HTTP '''200'''</ref>
* PC [[V-slips|virtual-slips]] '''Legacy Virtual Sets''' list '''VS1&ndash;VS17 only''', with no Fifth Anthology PDF row.<ref name="vslips" />

=== Released inside Reflections IV / Virtual Block 6 ===

'''Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV''' was published as [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], stamped '''Official text as of 4 September 2009'''.<ref name="vb6pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf] (titled Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV; official text '''4 September 2009''')</ref>

All six June preview titles appear on the Legacy [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html Virtual Block 6 cardlist] under Reflections IV packaging.<ref name="vb6list">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock6.html Virtual Block 6 cardlist], res.starwarsccg.org</ref> Two of them match the June preview text in the Reflections IV PDF:

* '''Luke Skywalker, Strong In The Force''' (#67): Pilot 3. While piloting Red 5 or Rogue 1 (or armed with Luke's Lightsaber), may add one destiny to total power or attrition, and ''I Have You Now'' is canceled. When leaving table, place all your cards on Luke in Used Pile. Immune to attrition &lt; 4.<ref name="vb6pdf" /><ref name="plfifth" />
* '''Maneuvering Flaps &amp; Nick Of Time''' (#81): Vehicles with a pilot character or gunner aboard are not hit when 'thrown'. During deploy phase, may reveal an unpiloted combat vehicle from hand to its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. Whenever you play Desperate Tactics, Lucky Shot, On Target, Rapid Fire, or Steady Aim, may draw top card from Reserve Deck; may not be suspended.<ref name="vb6pdf" /><ref name="plfifth" />

=== Not cancelled ===

The Polish Virtual Sets inventory lists '''VS18 Fifth Anthology''' '''without''' ''(niewydany)''. Only '''[[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War]]''' carries the ''(niewydany)'' / unreleased mark there.<ref name="plsets">[https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html Star Wars CCG &mdash; Virtual Sets], star-wars.pl</ref> The December 2009 Block intros also count a reorganization of the previous '''18''' virtual sets.<ref name="blockreorg" />

=== Not caused by the 2014 Reset ===

The PC article '''Reset of Standard Format''' is dated '''25 July 2014''', about five years later. It is a separate event ([[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]]).<ref name="reset">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Reset of Standard Format] (live) &mdash; [https://web.archive.org/web/20170306155342/http://www.starwarsccg.org/reset-of-standard-format/ Wayback]; byline '''25 July 2014'''</ref>

=== Modern Virtual Set 18 ===

[[Virtual Set 18]] (released '''21 April 2022'''; Current Virtual) is a different product from Original-era Fifth Anthology.

== [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|Galaxy At War]] and Block 6 ==

* The Polish inventory marks '''only [[Virtual Set 19: Galaxy At War|VS19 Galaxy At War]]''' as ''(niewydany)''.<ref name="plsets" />
* The PC Block intros describe Block 6 as the Reflections IV '''mix''' after the reorg of the previous 18 sets, not as Galaxy At War renamed.<ref name="blockreorg" />

Galaxy At War is also not Virtual Block / V-set '''9.2''', a 2014 Reset-era wording issue covered at [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]].
